skills.name: Hundred Rockets
skills.desc: Deals Quantum DMG equal to #1[i]% of Tribbie's Max HP to one designated enemy. Deals Quantum DMG equal to #2[i]% of Tribbie's Max HP to adjacent targets.

skills.name: Where'd the Gifts Go
skills.desc: Gains "Numinosity," lasting for #2[i] turn(s). This duration decreases by 1 at the start of this unit's every turn. While Tribbie has "Numinosity," increases all ally targets' All-Type RES PEN by #1[f1]%.

skills.name: Guess Who Lives Here
skills.desc:
Activates a Zone and deals Quantum DMG equal to #1[i]% of Tribbie's Max HP to all enemies.
While the Zone lasts, increases enemy targets' DMG taken by #2[f1]%. After an ally target attacks, for every 1 target hit, deals 1 instance of Quantum Additional DMG equal to #3[f1]% of Tribbie's Max HP to the target that has the highest HP among the hit targets.
The Zone lasts for #4[i] turn(s). This duration decreases by 1 at the start of this unit's every turn.

skills.name: Busy as Tribbie
skills.desc: After other ally characters use Ultimate, Tribbie launches Follow-Up ATK, dealing Quantum DMG equal to #1[f1]% of Tribbie's Max HP to all enemies. This effect triggers up to 1 time per character. When Tribbie uses Ultimate, resets the trigger count for other ally characters. If the target was defeated before the Follow-Up ATK is launched, then launches the Follow-Up ATK against new enemy targets entering the battlefield.

skills.name: If You're Happy and You Know It
skills.desc: After using Technique and upon entering battle, obtains "Numinosity," lasting for #1[i] turn(s).

passives.name: Lamb Outside the Wall...
passives.desc: After using Talent's Follow-Up ATK, increases the DMG dealt by Tribbie by 72%. This effect can stack up to 3 time(s), lasting for 3 turn(s).

passives.name: Glass Ball with Wings!
passives.desc: While the Zone lasts, Tribbie's Max HP increases by an amount equal to 9% of the sum of all ally characters' Max HP.

passives.name: Pebble at Crossroads?
passives.desc: At the start of battle, Tribbie regenerates 30 Energy. After other ally targets attack, Tribbie regenerates 1.5 Energy for each target hit.
